en.subtitle: Ruler, level, compass & more
en.short_description: Ruler, level, compass, protractor and barometer. Eleven tools, all offline.
en.description:
iMeasure turns the sensors already in your phone into a pocket toolkit. Eleven tools behind one dark HUD interface, and every one of them works offline.

—— The tools ——

SCREEN RULER
Measure small objects directly against your screen, in metric or imperial, horizontally or vertically.

LEVEL
A bubble level and a bullseye level driven by the accelerometer, for hanging a picture or checking a shelf.

COMPASS
A magnetometer heading dial.

PROTRACTOR
A gyroscope-backed dial for measuring angles, with lock and reset.

BAROMETER
Pressure, derived altitude, a weather read and a trend line. Falls back gracefully on devices with no pressure sensor.

PEDOMETER
Live step counting for a walking session.

UNIT CONVERTER
Six categories — length, weight, temperature, area, volume and speed — with accurate factors and proper temperature formulas rather than naive ratios.

NOISE METER
A sound-level gauge with a reference scale.

AI COACH
A chat assistant backed by an on-device knowledge base that explains which tool to use and how to get an accurate reading.

—— Built for real use ——

• Dark neon HUD designed to stay readable in a workshop or outdoors
• Metric and imperial throughout, remembered between sessions
• Dark and light themes
• Sign-in is optional — tap "Continue as guest" and every tool is available

—— Honest about accuracy ——

These readings come from consumer phone sensors. They are good enough for DIY, teaching and quick checks, and they are not calibrated instruments. Do not rely on them where a wrong measurement is expensive or unsafe.

review_information.notes:
Thanks for reviewing iMeasure.

iMeasure is an offline measurement toolkit driven by the device's own sensors. No account and no demo credentials are needed: the app opens straight into the tools, and sign-in is an optional row in Settings that gates no features.

Test instructions:
1. Launch the app and step through the three onboarding slides. Onboarding leads directly to the Home dashboard - there is no sign-in gate on the launch path.
2. The Home dashboard shows an eleven-tool grid. Tap Screen Ruler and measure any small object against the screen; the metric/imperial toggle is in the header.
3. Use the bottom tabs for Compass and Level - both read live from the device sensors. On a simulator these report no data, which is the expected graceful fallback; a physical device shows live values.
4. Tap Measure, then Unit Converter, and convert between any of the six categories.
5. Open Settings to switch units and theme, both persisted. Sign-in, if you wish to exercise it, is the "Sign in" row under "Account & data" and is entirely optional.
6. Tap Premium in the grid to view the paywall.

Privacy:
• Data collected: Nothing that identifies you. Sensor readings are processed on-device and not transmitted. Sign-in is optional; if you use it, your email is held by our authentication provider.
• Network: None required for any tool. The app functions fully offline. Network is used only if you choose to sign in.
• Location: Requested by the Compass only, and only to correct magnetic heading to true north. A low-accuracy fix is passed to an on-device geomagnetic model to compute magnetic declination; coordinates are never transmitted or stored. Declining the prompt is fully supported - the compass then reports magnetic north. No other tool requests location, and the barometer reads the pressure sensor, which is not a location service.
• Tracking: None. The app does not read the advertising identifier and shows no App Tracking Transparency prompt.

If you need anything else, please email contact@safecodeg.com and we will respond within one business day.
